title: The Key: reviewed property state

temporal_order.quote: In the flashback, Mira still has the key before the handoff.
The refused attempt happens after the handoff.

retraction.reason: Branch B's property update was superseded by the reviewed correction.

cases: Initial holder: Mira owns the key at the local origin.
Transfer: handoff atomically changes holder from Mira to Jon with an expected-old-state check.
Failed transfer: the refused attempt expects Mira after the handoff changed the holder to Jon; precheck rejects it and state remains Jon.
Observation: the flashback records Mira as the observed holder at that anchor and does not create a property-changing event.
Flashback: the reviewed temporal edge places the observation anchor before the handoff, so history can answer at the earlier boundary.
Branch conflict and retraction: unordered branch updates produce conflict; a reviewed retraction removes branch B from the rebuilt projection while retaining its history.
